  • fix/materials-prompt-stable-ack-20261027Ask about materials once per approved bid The approval question is now identified by the stable bid key within a workspace instead of key plus approval cycle, so re-approval, revisions and material edits no longer reopen it. Answers are stored per workspace (not per user), are no longer capped at 200, and legacy key|cycle answers are honored. Approved bids older than 48 hours are settled silently so history never becomes a queue of popups, and completed reserve/skip decisions are recorded. The dashboard notification id is stable per bid. Dismissing or acknowledging only writes browser storage; it never reserves, deducts or changes stock.

  • fix/client-wording-ready-state-20261027Show clear Ready / Reviewed / Saving / Not saved wording states - Each bid line now shows one status: "✓ Ready · Automatically matched", "✓ Ready · Reviewed" (after Done and a confirmed save), "Saving…", "Not saved" (with the reason), "Needs review" (meaningful identity, variant, scope or wording change), "Needs detail" (missing template values) and "No matching description" (no catalog wording yet). - Edit is now a small secondary action; Done records the review only when the wording is complete and the line has no issues. - The reviewed marker is a fingerprint of the stable source identity, chosen item/custom wording, details and work area, saved on the bid line. Cosmetic title edits keep it; it is shown as Reviewed only from the server-confirmed save, so a failed or pending save is never presented as saved. - No price, quantity, tax or total is read or written by this state.
